verdict.rationale: Whether a data platform's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Snowflake's own source is published under an open license. The public GitHub repo holds only OpenAPI specifications and Postman collections for the REST APIs, which describe the interface rather than the product's source, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
